verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a self-serve sandbox path. Clicking 'Start Now' drops users straight into the test dashboard, and test mode offers Stripe-managed test institutions that link without credentials. The client-side collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts method takes a server-issued client_secret, and Stripe publishes packages and an official CLI. Missing for 10: explicit self-serve API key issuance docs, a runnable end-to-end quickstart, a list of client libraries by language, and hands-on reports of time-to-first-link.
